required_boundary_copy.zh-CN: 此界面仅用于读取和追踪 Runtime，不创建建议、审批、任务或设备指令。
required_boundary_copy.en-US: This surface reads and traces Runtime only. It does not create recommendations, approvals, tasks, or device commands.

required_boundary_copy.zh-CN: 当前内容来自受控回放，不代表实时设备、生产网关或真实田间在线运行。
required_boundary_copy.en-US: Current content is controlled replay data. It does not establish live devices, a production gateway, or online field operation.

required_boundary_copy.zh-CN: Shadow-online 持续读取和计算，但不向真实世界发送控制指令。
required_boundary_copy.en-US: Shadow-online continuously reads and computes, but sends no control commands to the real world.

required_boundary_copy.zh-CN: 预测不是事实、建议或行动指令。
required_boundary_copy.en-US: A forecast is not a fact, recommendation, or action instruction.

required_boundary_copy.zh-CN: 情景比较用于只读推演，不创建建议或执行任务。
required_boundary_copy.en-US: Scenario comparison is read-only projection. It creates no recommendation or execution task.

required_boundary_copy.zh-CN: 残差用于验证预测偏差，不构成因果证明。
required_boundary_copy.en-US: Residuals evaluate forecast error; they are not causal proof.

required_boundary_copy.zh-CN: 运行健康描述当前受治理 Runtime 状态，不等同于生产监控或服务可用性承诺。
required_boundary_copy.en-US: Runtime Health describes the governed Runtime state. It is not a production-monitoring or service-availability commitment.

dynamic_copy_rules: SHADOW_ONLINE may appear only when runtime_mode is returned as SHADOW_ONLINE by the authoritative read model
fresh, stale, missing, degraded, recovered, backfilling, blocked, and completed are server verdict labels
all localized time copy must retain UTC in technical disclosure
reason codes may be translated for users but the exact code remains available
unknown values use explicit unknown copy and never a positive default
forbidden_claims: 设备在线，除非权威设备状态明确返回在线
生产网关在线，除非权威网关状态明确返回在线

error_copy_rules.zh-CN: 该精确范围尚未建立 Runtime。
error_copy_rules.en-US: Runtime is not established for this exact scope.

error_copy_rules.zh-CN: 请选择完整的租户、项目、组、地块、季节和分区范围。
error_copy_rules.en-US: Select the complete tenant, project, group, field, season, and zone scope.

error_copy_rules.zh-CN: Shadow-online 尚未获得运行授权。
Writer lease 冲突阻止当前运行；此界面不能接管 lease。
error_copy_rules.en-US: A writer-lease conflict blocks the current run. This surface cannot take over the lease.

error_copy_rules.zh-CN: 陈旧 fencing token 已被拒绝；此界面不能绕过校验。
error_copy_rules.en-US: A stale fencing token was rejected. This surface cannot bypass validation.
